Thank you,

Morgan Lee

workProduct.subject: Status update: Enrollment received — signature needed (FUL-3091)
workProduct.body:
Hi Taylor,

Thanks — we’ve received your enrollment and the pharmacy has recorded your prescription intake. One last step is needed: the consent form still needs your signature. Please complete the consent through the program’s secure channel so the pharmacy can confirm receipt and finish its administrative checks. Once those checks are complete, the pharmacy can determine if and when shipment can be scheduled; I can’t confirm any delivery date until they finish their checks.

If you think you’ve already signed the consent, reply here and I will ask intake to re-check the record.

Thanks,
Jordan Rivera
Willow Support
